DROP EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.covid_tracking_ext_table;


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.covid_tracking_ext_table
(
    date DATE,
    state VARCHAR(10),
    positive BIGINT,
    negative BIGINT,
    pending BIGINT,
    hospitalizedCurrently BIGINT,
    hospitalizedCumulative BIGINT,
    inIcuCurrently BIGINT,
    inIcuCumulative BIGINT,
    onVentilatorCurrently BIGINT,
    onVentilatorCumulative BIGINT,
    recovered BIGINT,
    death BIGINT,
    totalTestResults BIGINT
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'inputdata/covid_tracking.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = raw_Ext_source_practice,
    FILE_FORMAT = external_parquet_file
);



SELECT * FROM 
OPENROWSET
(
    BULK 'inputdata/covid_tracking.parquet',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'raw_Ext_source_practice',
    FORMAT='PARQUET'
) AS QUERY1;
